verdict.rationale: Snyk has several forms of unattended automation. Its docs describe fix workflows that open pull requests, and community users confirm Snyk sends automated PRs, though they complain about their quality. Snyk Studio's default hooks-based approach secures AI-assistant code automatically, and the CLI can run in CI/CD pipelines. However, the LLM Remediation Agent is invoked on demand (`/snyk-fix`, `snyk fix --agentic`) and is explicitly human-in-the-loop, not a background autonomous agent. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation or scheduling surface for autonomous background agent runs, documentation of autonomous (non-interactive) Remediation Agent operation, and positive independent corroboration of background automation working well.
